reason: I travel twice a month and pre-counted sachets I can toss in a bag is a real fix, plus the lab report on the box is more than most brands give. At the $24.99 launch price I'd try one box on impulse.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux or Goli and those last longer. Once the launch price ends I'd probably not reorder at full price.
would_change_my_mind: A creator video showing the sachet in a travel bag and sleeping better would push me to a second box; full price over $29.99 would flip me to no.
